# VehicleWheel

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("VehicleWheel")`

One wheel of a vehicle, under its `VehicleController`. It hangs from `Attachment`, an attachment of the chassis, on a suspension that pushes the chassis up where the wheel meets the ground; its tire then pushes the chassis along and across by how much it slips.

A wheel that steers has a `MaxSteerAngle`; one the engine turns is `Driven`. Driven wheels are paired in the order they are under the controller, left then right, so give a car's driven wheels left first.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attachment` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | The attachment of the chassis the suspension hangs from: the top of its travel. A wheel with no attachment, or with one on another part, is not part of the vehicle. |
| `Compression` | `number` | — | read-only | How far the suspension was pushed in at the last simulation tick, from 0 (fully out) to 1 (fully in). |
| `Driven` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the engine turns this wheel. |
| `Grip` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How well the tire holds the ground, as a scale of the ground's own friction: below 1 it slides sooner, above 1 later. |
| `Grounded` | `boolean` | — | read-only | Whether the wheel touched the ground at the last simulation tick. |
| `MaxBrakeTorque` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The brake's torque at full `Brake`, in newton meters. At 0 it is enough for the chassis' mass. |
| `MaxHandBrakeTorque` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The hand brake's torque at full `HandBrake`, in newton meters. At 0 the hand brake does not hold this wheel. |
| `MaxSteerAngle` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far the wheel turns at full `Steer`, in degrees. At 0 it does not steer. |
| `Radius` | `number` | `0.35` | read/write | The wheel's radius, in meters. |
| `Slip` | `number` | — | read-only | How much the tire slid sideways at the last simulation tick, as the angle between where it points and where it goes, in degrees. |
| `SuspensionDamping` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How much of a bounce the suspension takes away, from 0 (it bounces on) to 1 (it stops in one swing). |
| `SuspensionFrequency` | `number` | `1.5` | read/write | How stiff the suspension is, as the times a second it would bounce. 1 is soft, 2 is firm, 3 is a race car. |
| `SuspensionMaxLength` | `number` | `0.35` | read/write | The longest the suspension can be, in meters from the attachment to the wheel's center. |
| `SuspensionMinLength` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | The shortest the suspension can be, in meters from the attachment to the wheel's center. |
| `WheelPart` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | A part the engine places where the wheel is, turned by its steering and rolling, after each simulation tick. It should not collide: the wheel itself is not a part. |
| `Width` | `number` | `0.25` | read/write | The wheel's width, in meters. |
